item.description:
I give up. I’d rather fight Issin ten times in a row than have to beat the first phase of this boss for a 50th time.

>build issue
Possibly, but I got all the way to this point without much trouble only to run into an absolute brick wall that is required to proceed.

>skill issue
Yep.

Congrats, Romeo. I won’t be seeing the rest of the game because of you.
